answer.reason: The approach was wrong, and it has been rewritten. The tests shelled out to psql, which is absent on Windows (FileNotFoundError WinError 2) and only passed in CI because that workflow apt-installs postgresql-client - so the defect was invisible where it was written. Migrations now run through psycopg[binary], a wheel on every platform, already required by US-007, in a single transaction. Re-identifying as US-012 because answering this gate does not restore attempts: run.ts opens it whenever attempts >= maxAttempts without consulting a prior answer.
